source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Choose this [Rod of the War Forge](vsdata:ability/adeptus-mechanicus.thulia-ghuld.rod-of-the-war-forge) option during your Command phase. A friendly **SKITARII** unit up to 6″ from Ghuld gets the [Conqueror and Protector Imperatives](vsdata:ability/adeptus-mechanicus.doctrina-imperatives) together. They last until your next Command phase begins.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
